li_projects.title: Nicheify
li_projects.description: A full-stack webapp deployed on Vercel. It will take your Spotify profile and output a statistical breakdown of your listening habits, and a NicheScore showing how niche (or not) your music taste is.

li_projects.title: YouTube to MP3
li_projects.description: Developed a YouTube to MP3 converter using Python, CustomTkinter for the GUI, and Pytubefix for video downloading and conversion. Implemented key features like URL validation, progress tracking, and error handling to enhance user experience and reliability.

posts.text: Hey everyone! Excited to share a new project I’ve been working on: 𝗥𝗲𝗲𝗹𝗕𝗼𝘁, a Python-based tool that automates the creation of short-form storytelling content.
